risks.risk: The sensor may not be recognized by the Xbox One console.
risks.proof: A video showing the sensor being paired with an Xbox One and successfully detecting motion.

risks.risk: The sensor may be a counterfeit or third-party clone.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label or sticker on the sensor.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the sensor's lens with a distant object to check for scratches.
Video of the sensor being connected to an Xbox One and showing motion detection.
Photo of the sensor's label to confirm the model number.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
